parameters.name: DefenseScene
parameters.description:
The type of the WAF mitigation policy. Valid values:

- waf_group: Basic Web Protection.

- custom_acl: custom mitigation policy.

- whitelist: whitelist.

- ip_blacklist: IP blacklist.

- region_block: Location Blacklist.

- bot: bot management.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description: The Policy Name of the mitigation policy. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters (uppercase and lowercase), digits (0 to 9), and underscores (_). The name can be up to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: PolicyStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the mitigation policy. Valid values:

- on: enabled.

- off: disabled.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the current policy is the default policy. Valid values:

- default: default policy.

- custom: non-default policy.
